ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Shokkweave Economy
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Campaign law for the sole-source ruling in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_webwork.md section 6 ban 4: hyperweave IS shokkweave, renamed, and the Webwork is the only way to obtain it. Built for SHOKKWEAVE_SOLE_SOURCE_1, build-order step 1 (see design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/kits/shokkweave_sole_source_spec.md):
- Renames Hyperweave (defName UNCHANGED, Core shortHash 26103) to "shokkweave" with new flavor text. 617 RecipeDefs and every savegame reference keep working because the defName never moves. - The trader/quest/commonality strip and the rename's first half now live in the free mod mandrake.rm.webwork (thrixweave, WEBWORK_BASE_PORT_BUILD_1); this mod only repaints the same Hyperweave def as "shokkweave" and keeps the campaign-only routes below. - Gives the donor Wyyyschokk (mlie.starwarsanimalcollection) a small butcher yield of shokkweave: the silk is in the spider, not its hide (race.leatherDef untouched). - Web-cutting: RUT_Webwork_SilkKnot, a mineable silk vein scattered onto RUT_Webwork maps only, yields shokkweave when cut. - Nest raid: RUT_Webwork_Nest (MayRequire mlie.starwarsanimalcollection), a dormant lair guarded by a Wyyyschokk that wakes on approach; breaking it open drops a much larger shokkweave payout.
Out of scope here (see the item and spec): live trader-generation proof and the quest-reward roll pass (both need a quicktest map). The border creep-web structures (RM_Webwork_Anchor/_Web/_Gutter) and their small killedLeavings yield moved into mandrake.rm.webwork (WEBWORK_BASE_PORT_BUILD_1).
WEBWORK_EGG_BLACKMARKET_BUILD_1: the Hutt Cartel egg black market. RUT_Caravan_HuttCartel_EggMarket (a rare Cartel caravan variant, appended to RUT_Jawa_HuttCartel's caravanTraderKinds) sells 1-3 RM_OllathrixEgg at a premium and buys contraband-tagged eggs at ordinary price; RM_OllathrixEgg's tradeability opens to All here only, campaign-side (the free tier keeps Sellable — nests only). See ShokkweaveEggBlackMarket.xml for the leak-check reasoning and the one engine limit found while building it (no native XML buy-side price premium exists on any RimWorld trader).
